name: pw-duplicate-title-projects
notes: Project-crossing pitfall fixture for the playwright-native/1 composition (issue #55 / P1): `proj-a` and `proj-b` share the same testMatch (tests/dup.spec.ts) so the exact same test title runs once per project. src/adapters/playwright/recorder.ts derives test ids as `${rel}::${project}::${titles.join(' > ')}` (project-scoped), unlike the vitest recorder, which builds RecorderError on a duplicate id and would otherwise force degraded raw passthrough (spec §3.5 recorder invariants, §12 fail-closed on ambiguity). A clean `--report json` run (no degraded passthrough) with both project-scoped observations present is the machine-checkable proof that project inclusion in the id prevents that collision.
